items.title: Saudi, US housing ministers discuss cooperation in urban planning, property finance
items.source: Saudi Gazette – Business
items.source_excerpt: VIRGINIA — Minister of Municipalities and Housing Majed Al-Hogail discussed with US Secretary of Housing and Urban Development Scott Turner expanding bilateral cooperation between Saudi Arabia and the United States in housing, urban planning, and real estate finance. The meeting was held on the sidelines of the Ginnie Mae 2026 Global Investor Summit on Financing Affordable Housing in Virginia, the United States. The ministers reviewed ways to leverage regulatory and operational expertise to boost housing supply and incentivize private-sector investment, alongside developing real estate finance
